# Y's Men International (SWIR) - AI Hub & Business Directory

The official platform for the Y's Men International South West India Region (SWIR), featuring an exclusive membership directory, closed-claiming authentication, and an AI-driven hybrid semantic search pipeline.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling & Motion**: Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion 12
- **Backend & DB**: Supabase (PostgreSQL 15+), pgvector, Storage Buckets
- **AI Pipelines**: NVIDIA NIM (nvidia/nv-embedqa-e5-v5)
- **Transactional Mail**: Resend API, @react-email/render

## Core Architecture
- **Hybrid Search**: Fuses PostgreSQL Full-Text Search (FTS) with 1024-dimensional dense vector embeddings using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with tuning constant k=60.
- **Auth Engine**: Automatic Google OAuth matching against pre-populated admin stubs; alternative VIP IMIS ID cookie-lock verification workflow.

## Primary Route Directory
- `/` - Homepage with static legacy navigation and motto parallax canvas.
- `/about/history` - Sequential timeline tracing the 1922 legacy.
- `/about/philosophy` - Premium glassmorphic pillar panels (Duty, Service, Fellowship, Peace).
- `/directory` - Hybrid client-server marketplace listing with active category auto-fallback states.
- `/directory/[id]` - Spotlight details with member voucher templates and lead enquiry forms.
- `/region/leadership` - Cabinet role profiles with interactive touch targets.
- `/region/calendar` - Real-time client-side program schedule and date filter matrix.
- `/dashboard` - Protected administrative interface for business profile telemetry.
- `/dashboard/onboarding` - Zod-validated multi-part business profiling and asset compiler.
